subject: Media Literacy
title: Advertising to Children
description: A short lesson to help you apply Advertising to Children.

hook.text: Children under 8 cannot distinguish between ads and content. Advertisers spend $17 billion targeting them anyway.

buildup.text: Children are a prime advertising audience because they influence family purchases and become lifelong brand loyalists.

discovery.text: Kids' YouTube channels blur content and advertising through toy reviews that are often paid promotions.

twist.text: Some countries ban advertising to children entirely. The US relies mostly on industry self-regulation.

climax.text: Targeting people who can't tell ads from reality isn't marketing. It's manipulation of the defenseless.

punchline.text: They can't spot the ad. That's exactly why it works.

quiz.question: Why are children a prime target for advertisers?
options: They influence family purchases and develop lifelong brand loyalty
They watch more TV than adults
